scope: exact two current R001 research attempts, not earlier I01 or later pipelines
usage_definition: Known native provider-request sums. Cache is a subset of input/total, never added. UI usage is a separate counter/baseline and never added. Unknown cancelled/child/unexposed tails and dollars remain unknown.
occupied_definition: Sum of each native receipt-accounted occupied_seconds, includes native setup/cleanup; not cohort elapsed wall or all pipeline effort. Dispatcher/end-to-end timings can use a different scope.
terminal_goal_status_in_native_receipts: UNKNOWN_NOT_SAVED_IN_THIS_RECEIPT for both; job FAILED/cap/error and cleanup exit0 do not imply Goal COMPLETE/FAILED
pipeline_credit: NONE_QUALIFIED; no later final and stage jobs failed. Full pipeline source quality UNASSESSED.
unknown_facets: later stages/final cost and full pipeline quality
independent evaluator model/effort receipt and evaluator token usage
